1.outline: Term theme: 'Multimedia & Web'. Plan a small awareness campaign (e.g. recycling, online safety) combining a video and a website.
1.sowResources: Printed storyboard sheet, campaign brief handout.
objectives: Choose a campaign topic and message.
Storyboard a short video for the campaign.
Plan how the video and website will connect.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: What makes a campaign work
plan.detail: Look at real campaign examples — one clear message, consistent look.

plan.title: Storyboard
plan.detail: Choose a topic and storyboard a 60-90 second campaign video.

plan.title: Pitch it
plan.detail: Pitch the campaign idea to a partner. Log out.

successCriteria: I chose a clear campaign topic and message.
My storyboard plans a short video.
I can pitch my campaign idea to a partner.

2.outline: Film the campaign video's shots and gather any images or graphics needed for the site.
objectives: Film shots following the storyboard.
Apply good filming practice: steady, lit, clear sound.
Gather additional images for the website.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Film the shots
plan.detail: Film the storyboard's shots, applying steady/lit/clear-sound rules.

plan.title: Gather assets
plan.detail: Collect any extra photos or graphics needed for the campaign website.

plan.title: Devices in
plan.detail: Devices counted in. Log out.

successCriteria: I filmed shots following the storyboard.
My filming followed the steady/lit/clear-sound rules.
I gathered images needed for the website.

3.outline: Edit the campaign video: trim, order, add a title and captions, and background music at a sensible volume.
objectives: Trim and order the clips.
Add a title and captions.
Add background music at a sensible volume.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Edit the video
plan.detail: Trim clips, order them, add a title, captions and background music.

plan.title: Full playback
plan.detail: Play through and check it delivers the campaign message clearly. Save and log out.

successCriteria: My clips are trimmed and in a sensible order.
My video has a title and captions.
My video's message is clear on a full playback.

4.outline: Build a campaign website with a home page introducing the message and a page for the video and supporting information.
objectives: Build a campaign website structure.
Write a clear home page introducing the campaign.
Plan where the video will go.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Build the site
plan.detail: Build the home page and a second page, planning where the video will be embedded.

plan.title: Message check
plan.detail: Check the site's message is clear and consistent with the video. Save and log out.

successCriteria: My site has a home page and a second page.
My home page clearly introduces the campaign.
My site's message is consistent with my video.

5.outline: Embed the finished campaign video and gathered images into the site.
objectives: Embed the campaign video into the site.
Add gathered images to relevant pages.
Check the media displays correctly.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Embed and add media
plan.detail: Embed the video and add images to the site's pages.

plan.title: Check display
plan.detail: Check the video plays and images display correctly. Save and log out.

successCriteria: My video is embedded and plays correctly.
My images are added to the relevant pages.
All media displays correctly.

6.outline: Under teacher guidance, generate campaign copy or images with an AI tool, editing and crediting them responsibly.
objectives: Use a guided AI tool to generate campaign copy or images.
Edit AI output to fit the campaign's message.
Credit AI-made content correctly.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Generate assets
plan.detail: Under supervision, generate copy or images for the campaign using the guided AI tool.

plan.title: Edit and credit
plan.detail: Edit the AI output and add a credit line where used.

plan.title: Add to the site
plan.detail: Add the credited content to the site. Save and log out.

successCriteria: I generated content with the guided AI tool.
I edited it to fit the campaign message.
My AI-made content is correctly credited.

7.outline: Publish the campaign site and check it against digital citizenship standards: privacy, honesty and fair use.
objectives: Publish the campaign site.
Check the site against a citizenship checklist.
Fix any issues found.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Citizenship check
plan.detail: Check the site against the checklist: privacy, honesty, AI credits, appropriate content.

plan.title: Publish
plan.detail: Fix any issues and publish the site.

plan.title: Peer visit
plan.detail: A partner visits the published site to confirm it works. Log out.

successCriteria: I checked my site against the citizenship checklist.
My site is published correctly.
A partner confirmed my published site works.

8.outline: Present the finished campaign — video and website — to the class, explaining the message and how it was built.
objectives: Present the finished campaign to the class.
Explain the campaign's message clearly.
Save the campaign to the portfolio.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Present the campaign
plan.detail: Present the video and site to the class, explaining the message.

plan.title: Questions
plan.detail: Answer one audience question about the campaign.

plan.title: Save
plan.detail: Save the campaign to the portfolio folder. Log out.

successCriteria: I presented my finished campaign to the class.
I explained the campaign's message clearly.
My campaign is saved to the portfolio folder.

9.outline: Apply one piece of feedback received during the presentation to improve the campaign video or site.
objectives: Choose one useful piece of feedback.
Apply it to the video or site.
Re-check the campaign still works.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Apply feedback
plan.detail: Choose one piece of feedback and apply it to the video or site.

plan.title: Re-check
plan.detail: Check the campaign still works after the change.

plan.title: Save
plan.detail: Save and log out.

successCriteria: I chose one useful piece of feedback.
I applied it to my campaign.
My campaign still works correctly.

10.outline: Rehearse the term's multimedia and web skills in pairs: storyboard, film, edit, build, publish.
10.sowResources: Recap slide deck, practice task cards.
objectives: Recall the term's process in order.
Rehearse a short filming-to-website task with a partner.
Identify the trickiest step.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Process recap
plan.detail: Recap: storyboard, film, edit, site, embed, AI, publish — as a class chant.

plan.title: Paired rehearsal
plan.detail: Practise a short filming-to-website task with a partner reading the task card, then swap.

plan.title: Tricky step check
plan.detail: Name the step you still find hardest. Log out.

successCriteria: I can list the term's process in order.
I rehearsed the practical task with a partner.
I know which step needs more practice.

11.outline: Individual task: produce a published campaign site with an original edited video and clearly credited AI-assisted assets.
objectives: Produce an edited video to a brief.
Build and publish a campaign site.
Use AI assets responsibly with clear credits.

plan.title: Settle and explain
plan.detail: Calm start — explain the task.

plan.title: Build the campaign
plan.detail: Individual practical: assemble the video and site using pre-gathered assets.

plan.title: Publish and check
plan.detail: Publish the site and check AI credits are correct.

plan.title: Celebrate
plan.detail: Save and celebrate the year's progress. Log out.

successCriteria: My video is edited and meets the brief.
My site is built and published.
My AI-assisted assets are clearly credited.

12.outline: Plan a bigger final campaign with a second video, an extra page, and a call to action.
objectives: Plan a second campaign video or extended site.
Plan a clear call to action.
Sketch the additional content.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Plan the extension
plan.detail: Plan a second video or extra page, and a clear call to action for visitors.

plan.title: Pitch it
plan.detail: Tell a partner the plan. Collect plans. Log out.

successCriteria: My plan extends the campaign meaningfully.
My plan includes a clear call to action.
I can tell a partner my plan.

13.outline: Build the extended campaign content, following the plan.
objectives: Build the extended video or page.
Add the call to action.
Test the extension works with the existing site.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Build the extension
plan.detail: Build the second video or extra page with the call to action.

plan.title: Test it
plan.detail: Test it fits with the existing campaign. Save and log out.

successCriteria: My extension is built and complete.
My call to action is clear.
My extension fits with the existing campaign.

14.outline: Final citizenship check, re-publish the full campaign, and rehearse presenting the extended version.
objectives: Do a final citizenship check.
Re-publish the extended campaign.
Rehearse presenting it.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Final check
plan.detail: Check the whole campaign against the citizenship checklist.

plan.title: Re-publish
plan.detail: Re-publish the extended campaign.

plan.title: Rehearse
plan.detail: Practise presenting the full campaign to a partner. Log out.

successCriteria: My campaign passed a final citizenship check.
My extended campaign is re-published.
I rehearsed presenting it to a partner.

15.outline: Launch the finished campaign to the class as a 'launch day' event, and save the whole year's portfolio.
objectives: Present the finished campaign confidently.
Explain the campaign's impact and message.
Save the whole year's portfolio.

plan.title: Final rehearsal
plan.detail: One last run-through with a partner before presenting.

plan.title: Campaign Launch Day
plan.detail: Present campaigns to the class in small groups.

plan.title: Portfolio save
plan.detail: Save the finished campaign and review the whole year's portfolio folder.

plan.title: Year celebration
plan.detail: Name three things learned this year. Log out.

successCriteria: I presented my finished campaign confidently.
I explained its message and impact.
My whole year's work is saved in the portfolio.
